result.description:
SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK tes Pty Ltd
Location: Union Cct YATALA QLD 4207
Job Type: Casual 
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

Role Overview

An IT Recycle Operator is responsible for the proper disposal and recycling of information technology (IT) equipment that has reached the end of its useful life. The role involves handling electronic waste (e-waste) in an environmentally responsible manner, ensuring compliance with regulations, and promoting sustainable practices. The IT Recycle Operator plays a crucial role in reducing the environmental impact of discarded IT assets and supporting the organization's commitment to responsible recycling. 

An operator will work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities. Operators will be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets. 

Where an operator has the necessary licences, training and ability, an operator may be required to operate machinery as directed by their line manager.

Key Accountabilities

•	Be responsible for the quality assurance of their own work.
•	Works under routine supervision, either individually or in a team environment.
•	Being able to lift to 15kg.
•	Complete necessary training materials, a directed by the business.
•	Follow all reasonable directions of the Team Leader.
•	Maintain accurate records and inventory of all disposed assets.
•	Some of the daily work activities include receiving, sorting, testing, warehousing, data destruction, and de-manufacturing.
•	General tasks associated with the receiving and dispatch of assets.
•	Able to maintain records or reports in accordance with company procedures.
•	Operators will rotate and work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities and be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets.
•	Perform data sanitization and secure data destruction processes on all retired IT assets to prevent data breaches and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
•	Safely and responsibly handle the dismantling and disposal of electronic components following proper procedures.
•	Conduct accurate testing and assessment of returned assets to determine their potential for refurbishment or reuse as per the guidelines.
•	Conduct Inventory Stock Take activities.
•	May be directed to perform other duties consistent with training and skill levels required for this position.
•	Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring data security throughout the ITAD process.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

•	Experience in Warehousing (Preferable) 
•	A valid forklift licence is a PLUS but not required
•	Effective communication skills
•	Basic admin/data entry capability
•	Understanding of IT hardware components and familiarity with various types of electronic devices.
•	Physical fitness to handle and move electronic equipment.
•	Ability to operate recycling machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
•	Strong attention to detail to ensure proper sorting and disposal of e-waste.

What We Offer

•	Competitive remuneration package
•	Career progression opportunities
•	Ongoing training and professional development
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment
•	Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation

Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
We are seeking a passionate and nurturing Child Care Worker for an exclusive partnership with a prestigious, community-focused preschool. This role is ideal for an educator who believes in the power of a holistic, play-based approach and values creating a warm, homelike environment for children. The centre prides itself on its beautiful, natural settings and its philosophy that emphasises emotional security, creativity, and foundational learning through exploration. We are looking for a dedicated professional who can contribute to this nurturing atmosphere, design a stimulating program inspired by the Early Years Learning Framework, and build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the wider community. This is a unique opportunity to join a team deeply committed to providing an exceptional early learning experience.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Web Administrator to join our team and take ownership of our web presence, infrastructure, and digital platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining websites while delivering reliable web technology solutions that support the organisation's objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our web environments are secure, performant, and continuously optimised. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications, ensuring consistent functionality, visual integrity, and a positive user experience across all platforms
- Monitor and manage web server performance, uptime, and availability, responding promptly to incidents and implementing preventative measures to minimise disruption
- Administer and configure web hosting environments, domains, DNS settings, and SSL certificates to ensure secure and reliable operation
- Collaborate with content, marketing, and development teams to publish, update, and manage web content in accordance with brand guidelines and accessibility standards
- Implement and maintain web security protocols, including regular vulnerability assessments, software patching, and user access controls to safeguard digital assets
- Analyse web traffic data and performance metrics using analytics tools, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve engagement and site effectiveness
- Manage and maintain content management systems (CMS), including configuration, plugin or module updates, and user permission management
- Develop and enforce web standards, coding best practices, and documentation to ensure consistency and maintainability across all web properties
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to websites, web applications, and integrations in a timely and effective manner
- Support the planning and execution of website migrations, upgrades, and redesign projects, coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors as required
- Conduct regular audits of website content, links, and functionality to identify and rectify errors, broken pages, or outdated information
- Provide technical guidance and support to internal users on web-related tools, platforms, and best practices
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Proven experience in a web administration, web development, or similar technical role
- Proficiency in core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Hands-on experience administering web servers such as Apache or Nginx, and working within Linux or Windows server environments
- Solid understanding of DNS management, domain administration, SSL/TLS certificates, and web hosting infrastructure
- Experience managing content management systems such as WordPress, Drupal, or similar platforms
- Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar, with the ability to interpret data and report findings clearly
- Working knowledge of web security best practices, including vulnerability management and access control
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Google Analytics, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or CompTIA Security+
- Experience with version control systems such as Git and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows
- Knowledge of PHP, Python, or other server-side scripting languages
- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
- Exposure to cloud-based hosting platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure
- Experience working within agile or collaborative project delivery environments
- Familiarity with web performance optimisation techniques, including caching strategies and content delivery networks (CDNs)
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and shared success

Full job description 

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications. 

Monitor and support customer deployments, ensuring high availability, proactive issue resolution, and continual improvements. 

Spearhead mobile app security using authentication, encryption, and data protection best practices. 

Manage the scalability and performance optimization of Ezy-Serve and mobility solutions for large enterprise customers. 

 

 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Hands-on experience in Ezy-Serve and Change-Ezy SaaS products, with multiple deployments. 

Proficiency in Android (Java), iOS (Swift), Angular WebApplication, and Restful Integration for enterprise field mobility applications. 

Strong experience in GIS mapping solutions within Ezy-Serve, S/4 HANA, Ezy-Day and ESRI ArcGIS. 

Expertise in Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture. 

Experience in customer support, implementation, and SaaS product maintenance. 

Proven track record of integrating mobile apps with ERP and enterprise systems. 

Experience leading cross-functional teams, including backend, frontend, and cloud engineers. 

Excellent customer relationship management and communication skills. 

Experience in IoT-driven FSM applications. 

Hands-on experience with SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions. 

Strong knowledge of serverless architectures, AWS, and cloud-native technologies. 

Must have hands on experience in Ezy -Serve solutions and high-traffic FSM solutions with thousands of active users. 

This role is open only to candidates with experience working on Ezy-Serve. Candidates with experience in Ezy-Serve or Change-Ezy solutions are needed. 

Job Type: Full-time 

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year 

Education: 

Bachelor Degree (mandatory) 

Experience: 

IT: 9+ years (Required) 

SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions: 7+ years (Required)

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.




About the Department - Program 


Join Monash Health as a Quality Systems & Insights Analyst and play a key role in improving the safety and quality of care for one of Victoria's largest health services. Combining data analytics, quality systems expertise and clinical governance insight, you'll transform information into meaningful action, support organisation wide quality systems, and help leaders make decisions that improve patient outcomes. If you enjoy solving problems, working with data, optimising systems, and partnering with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement and positive change, this is an opportunity to make a real impact across a complex and dynamic healthcare environment.


The Quality & Clinical Governance Unit plays a central role in supporting Monash Health's commitment to delivering safe, effective and high-quality care. The team provides leadership, systems and oversight that strengthen clinical governance, quality improvement, patient safety and organisational learning across the health service.


The Quality Insights & Systems team manages and optimises key quality systems, supports the collection and analysis of clinical governance information, and provides meaningful insights that help leaders identify risks, monitor performance and drive continuous improvement. Working collaboratively with programs and services across Monash Health, the team supports evidence-based decision-making and initiatives that enhance patient outcomes and organisational performance.







About the Role 








This is a part time ongoing position located at Monash Medical Centre, Clayton, you will work under the leadership of the Quality Insights & Systems manager and collaborate closely with the broader Quality & Clinical Governance team and stakeholders across Monash Health.


This is an exciting opportunity for a quality systems and data professional who enjoys combining analytical thinking, systems administration and continuous improvement to support safer patient care. The role is responsible for maintaining and optimising key organisational quality systems while developing meaningful clinical governance insights that inform decision-making and improvement initiatives.










Key responsibilities include:



Administering and optimising Monash Health's quality systems, including incident management, document control and audit platforms.


Analysing clinical quality data and other information sources to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. 


Developing and delivering clinical governance reports, dashboards and insights that support leaders and teams. 


Providing user support, education and training to improve staff capability in quality systems and data interpretation. 


Working with internal stakeholders, external vendors and partner teams to enhance system performance, data integrity and governance processes. 


Contributing to quality improvement initiatives, system enhancements and process optimisation projects.









This role will involve working with stakeholders across multiple Monash Health sites. A hybrid working arrangement may be available in line with team and organisational requirements.







About You 


To be successful in this healthcare role, you will bring demonstrated experience in systems administration, data analysis and quality improvement within a complex organisational environment. 


You will be someone who is curious, analytical and solutions-focused, with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights and build strong collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.


You will have:




Experience administering, supporting or improving systems and processes in a complex organisation. 


Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and communicate actionable insights. 


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations and development of guidance materials.


Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building capabilities. 


Experience providing education, training and support to end-users.


High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining data integrity and quality. 


Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset. 


Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.


Experience using RiskMan, PROMPT, MARS or similar systems will be highly regarded.



Mandatory Requirements:




Degree qualification in health, quality, business management, data analytics or a related discipline.


Current right to work in Australia. 


Ability to obtain and maintain required screening checks, including National Police Check and Working with Children Check.


Current Victorian Driver's Licence is highly desirable



 
Desirable:




Knowledge of quality, safety and clinical governance principles within a health service environment. 


Experience working in a complex healthcare organisation.This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to Monash Health's quality and safety agenda, helping to strengthen systems, generate valuable organisational insights and support continuous improvement across one of Australia's largest health services. 










For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Linda Chuang, Qualtiy Insights & Systems Manager via linda.chuang@monashhealth.org
